name: Mike Vhiles
description: Mike Vhiles, a band from Coimbra, performs a series of sonic eruptions with fuzz and guttural distortion. Their music reflects on accumulated bad decisions.
longDescription:
Mike Vhiles, a band originating from Coimbra, will perform at Maus Hábitos in Porto. The event is scheduled for Thursday, November 5, 2026, running from 9:30 PM to 11:30 PM.

The band's sound is characterized by sonic eruptions, fuzz, and guttural distortion, drawing comparisons to apocalyptic films. They focus on themes of accumulated bad decisions.

Tickets for the performance are available for €7.00. Maus Hábitos is located at Rua de Passos Manuel 178, 4º Piso, 4000-382 Porto.
